conclusions.run: Local SDK starts a new scan unless undocumented CLI-internal options are supplied.
conclusions.publicAPI: CodexSecurity and ScanOptions have no public resume() / resumeScanId entry point.
conclusions.cli: Upstream CLI supports eligible running Deep scans; not exposed through this Web adapter.
conclusions.applicationRecovery: Restore only a verified complete result commit, otherwise require explicit reexecution and preserve evidence.
